> Compatibility reference derived from Tera Term. TTL syntax and command behaviour apply to Sterna; executable and UI instructions describe upstream.

# TTL command reference

This index contains the 209 command spellings accepted by Sterna's
default TTL interpreter, backed by 208 command implementations.
It is generated from [`rsv.rs`](../../../crates/tt-ttl/src/rsv.rs); adding a
command without documenting it makes generation fail.

The individual pages are mechanically converted from the English Tera Term
manual at the revision named in the generated-file header. TTL runs inside
Sterna rather than in `TTPMACRO.EXE`, but its command syntax and observable
behaviour are kept compatible.
